# Maria Blair, AI Consulting

> Private, in-person AI training and setup for small businesses in Boca Raton, Delray Beach and Palm Beach County, Florida. Maria Blair comes to the client's office and puts AI to work on the team's real daily tasks, in plain English. Remote work is available anywhere.

Maria Blair is a senior software engineer with more than 11 years of experience, a former engineer at Yardi (RentCafe and facilities teams), and the creator of the YouTube channel Maria Talks Tech. She is based in Boca Raton, Florida.

## Services

- **AI Team Training** (where most clients start): hands-on training at the client's office, on the team's own daily tasks.
- **AI Implementation Sprint**: finding the biggest time-wasters and building the fixes together: a shared AI "business brain" with the company's policies and documents, templates for repeat work, and AI connected to email, calendar and files.
- **AI Receptionist & Website Chat**: an always-on assistant for phone and website that uses the business's own hours, policies and pricing to answer routine questions, book appointments and capture leads, and passes anything urgent to staff.
- **Ongoing Support**: a monthly check-in to add workflows, answer questions and keep the team current.

## Pricing

- Free 20-minute call to see whether AI training is a fit.
- AI Training Session: $99 per hour, 1 hour minimum, 1 to 10 hours, booked and paid online.
- Team workshops, implementation sprints and automation projects are quoted after the free call.

## Who it is for

Owners and teams of small businesses who want practical results without jargon, including property management, real estate offices, law firms, med spas and clinics. Also individuals who want to learn AI for work, career or everyday life. Tools used are mostly Claude and ChatGPT, connected to Google Workspace or Microsoft 365.

## Service area

In person in Boca Raton, Delray Beach, West Palm Beach and elsewhere in Palm Beach County, Florida. Remote anywhere.

## How to start

- [Request a free 20-minute call](https://mariablairai.com/#free-call): short form on the home page; Maria replies within one business day.
- [Free 3-minute AI assessment](https://mariablairai.com/assessment): about 11 questions; results (AI level, three next steps, a suggested starting point) are emailed.
- [Book an AI Training Session](https://buy.stripe.com/7sY3cn5jKflV2NN8fm6sw04): $99 per hour, paid by card.
